claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can validate compiler_stack_provenance metadata for workload/model configuration, FlashAttention/Pallas kernel identity, JAX pre/postprocessing boundaries, XLA lowering stage, hardware target, lowered-IR hash, optimization decision category, and artifact refs. It does not claim real workload/model configuration records, FlashAttention kernel artifacts, Pallas kernel source artifacts, JAX preprocessing wrapper artifacts, JAX postprocessing wrapper artifacts, XLA lowering-stage records, hardware-target records, lowered-IR artifacts, optimization decision evidence, memory-access orchestration evidence, computation-scheduling evidence, or complete stack artifact refs.
source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.4 places the optimized compiler-generated FlashAttention code inside a Pallas/JAX/XLA stack for a high-impact GPU inference configuration. The paper explains that improved memory-access orchestration or computation scheduling can reduce runtime on particular hardware without attributing every reported edit to one of those categories.
